summary: Refactor regression complete. server.py split into routes/{prescriptions,consultations,clinics,hexa}.py with /app/backend/shared.py as single source of truth. Re-ran existing Phase 1 (15) + Phase 2/3 (27) test suites — all 42 pass. Added 23 new refactor-regression tests covering preexisting routes (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/appointments, /api/clients, /api/analytics/dashboard, /api/admin/users), extracted router paths, empty-email coercion on POST /api/clinics (no 422), Hexa search with regex metacharacters (O'Brien, a.b*c, (test)+, ?weird — none crash thanks to re.escape), Hexa write-intent confirmation gating, and receptionist permission boundary (403 on consultations/hexa/opd; 200 on appointments/clients). Total: 65/65 backend tests pass. Frontend smoke: login→/dashboard works (OPD widget renders), /clinics, /consultations all render cleanly with no ErrorBoundary triggered, Seal of Privacy visible, floating Hexa sparkle button present. ErrorBoundary confirmed mounted at top level of App.js wrapping all routes. Behavior is UNCHANGED — refactor is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 3572 lines after extracting 4 routers — the remaining ~3500 lines still violate the 700-line guideline. Strong candidates for further extraction: appointments, clients, payments/subscriptions, WhatsApp bot, voice bot, auth/admin. Recommend continuing the modularization in the next phase.

shared.py reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME via os.environ[...] at module import time. If shared.py is imported BEFORE load_dotenv runs in some import order, it will KeyError. Currently safe because shared.py calls load_dotenv() at top, but a future refactor of server.py that imports shared.py earlier (or pytest collection in another path) could break. Consider lazy connection or guard with os.environ.get + clearer error.

routes/clinics.py imports from shared but also imports `from security import PasswordValidator, InputSanitizer` — relative module path works only because backend runs with cwd /app/backend. If anyone runs uvicorn from /app, imports will fail. Consider explicit `from backend.security import ...` or keep sys.path setup documented.

All extracted routers use insert_one(doc.copy()) defensively — good. But this pattern is now duplicated 4x. Recommend a tiny helper `await db.X.insert_doc(doc)` in shared.py that does the copy internally, to avoid future regressions of the ObjectId-in-response bug.

Hexa BackgroundTasks fix is correct, but errors inside background_tasks.add_task(send_whatsapp_message, ...) are swallowed by FastAPI; failures will only appear in logs. For ops visibility, consider wrapping the task in a wrapper that logs success/failure to a `hexa_outbox` collection.

routes/consultations.py has require_doctor_or_owner dep AND a separate `if profession != 'doctor': 403` inside the handler — redundant once receptionists are blocked at the dependency. Either trust the dep or drop it.
routes/hexa.py uses re.escape via shared.safe_regex — verified working for ', ., *, (, ), +, ? in test_refactor_regression.py.

Frontend ErrorBoundary is mounted at the top of App.js (line 80 → 234, wrapping all <Routes>). Confirmed via grep + live navigation — no crashes propagate to blank page across /dashboard, /clinics, /consultations. Good.
Pre-existing bcrypt warning in backend logs (passlib + bcrypt __about__) is cosmetic, does not block login/sub-user creation — left as-is.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, dashboard OPD, /clinics, /consultations, Hexa button, Seal of Privacy, ErrorBoundary mount — all verified)
